answer: Creating fake identities costs the full bond plus attestation effort, and colluding clusters are slashed when caught, so their expected payoff drops below honest participation. Sybil resistance here uses stake-weighted reputation slot bonding: each agent locks a bond that decays over a long horizon, and reputation accrues in a spiral only when peers attest real work. A shared lagoon of verified attestations makes cheap throwaway accounts visible and rejected by peers. In practice, sa0011 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
